items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: because we was, you know, family.

ctx.x: Tell me about that meeting. What happened?

Well, he sent me a cable from Chicago and said, 'Nacho, I am sick and tired to be running all over the country', and so on and so on, 'and wind up with anything because it's too expensive' or whatever, 'so I am going to New York and I am going to join your band and we get together. Don't worry, I rehearse the band and prepare everything', and whatever. I said, no, no, no, no, let's be half and half, we pay all the expenses and we divide whatever. And he said okay, because we was, you know, family.
